name: gizza-ai/censor-text
summary: Redact words in text by masking.

tool.description: Redact words in text by masking them with a character. Provide a comma-separated `words` list (or leave it empty to use a built-in common-profanity list). Matching is case-insensitive; by default only whole words are masked (set whole_word=false to also catch matches inside larger words). `mask` sets the masking character (default '*').

words.description: Comma-separated words to redact. Leave empty to use a built-in common-profanity list.

mask.description: Masking character (its first char is used). Default '*'.

whole_word.description: When true (default), only whole-word matches are masked; false also masks matches inside larger words.
